title: Consultor de processos - eva e cdr
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.
Sobre a Arauco Brasil
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.
Sobre a Função
Desafios:
Oferecer suporte técnico especializado na operação e otimização dos processos de Evaporação e Caldeira de Recuperação, através do mapeamento, monitoramento dos processos e gestão dos recursos, consumos de insumos e materiais de operação, sistemas e equipamentos, assegurando a produtividade das áreas de Evaporação e Caldeira de Recuperação, dentro do padrão de qualidade e eficiência, otimizando custos e minimizando desperdício, através de intervenções nos parâmetros e processos, implementação de novas tecnologias ou métodos de produção, visando a melhoria contínua no desempenho dos equipamentos, bem como, realizar a gestão técnica dos operadores da sua área de atuação.
Principais Atividades:
Desenvolver, validar e implementar planos de otimização dos processos produtivos, garantindo eficiência operacional, qualidade e melhor uso de recursos.
Monitorar e aprimorar continuamente os sistemas de Evaporação e Caldeira de Recuperação, com foco em redução de custos, aumento de produtividade e sustentabilidade.
Acompanhar as operações diárias, assegurando conformidade com padrões de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente.
Garantir atendimento às normas e regulamentações aplicáveis (ISOs, NRs), promovendo práticas seguras e sustentáveis.
Atuar na capacitação das equipes operacionais, disseminando melhores práticas e apoiando o desenvolvimento técnico após startup da planta.
Trabalhar de forma integrada com Engenharia, Manutenção, Produção e Qualidade em projetos de melhoria, modernização e aumento de disponibilidade dos ativos.
Participar do planejamento e execução de Paradas Gerais, contribuindo com estratégias para mitigação de riscos, otimização de custos e gestão de fornecedores.
Implantar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (custos, disponibilidade, produtividade), promovendo ajustes e melhorias contínuas.
Promover a cultura de Segurança, Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Saúde Ocupacional e Compliance em todas as atividades.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:
Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
Pós-graduação ou especialização em Celulose e Papel, Gestão de Projetos, Lean Manufacturing ou áreas afins;
Sólida experiência em indústria de celulose;
Vivência em comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
Conhecimento consolidado em sistemas de gestão da qualidade (normas ISO);
Experiência com metodologias de análise e solução de problemas;
Conhecimento em design experimental (DOE) e estatística avançada;
Conhecimento em gestão com foco no cliente;
Domínio técnico dos processos de Evaporação e Caldeira de Recuperação;
Amplo conhecimento do processo produtivo de celulose e papel;
Experiência com Sistema PIMS e Balanço de Produção;
Vivência em Gestão da Rotina Diária (GRD);
Inglês e Espanhol serão considerados diferenciais;
Disponibilidade para atuar em Inocência/MS.

title: Director talent acquisition
description:
The Talent Acquisition Director for Brazil is responsible for defining and executing a comprehensive national recruitment strategy aligned with business growth, client demand, and local labor market dynamics. This role ensures the attraction, selection, and retention of high-quality talent across multiple sites and business lines within Brazil, while driving innovation, operational excellence, and diversity in hiring practices.
Role Responsibilities
1. Strategic Leadership & Planning
Define and execute the Brazil Talent Acquisition strategy aligned with company objectives, national headcount plans, and client demand forecasts.
Partner with Brazil Operations, HR, Finance, and Workforce Management leaders to anticipate talent needs and capacity requirements.
Translate national business goals into actionable recruitment plans and measurable KPIs.
Develop workforce planning insights to proactively address hiring volume fluctuations, seasonal peaks, and new business ramp-ups within Brazil.
Leverage Brazilian labor market intelligence to inform location strategy, compensation competitiveness, and sourcing channels.
2. National Team Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop Talent Acquisition Managers and recruitment teams across multiple Brazilian sites to ensure consistent execution, capability building, and engagement.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Ensure alignment with global TA frameworks, tools, and employer branding standards while adapting them to Brazil’s cultural and market realities.
Drive recruiter capability development in high-volume BPO hiring and specialized talent segments.
3. Operational Excellence
Oversee end-to-end recruitment operations across all Brazil delivery centers and remote hiring markets, ensuring timely, quality, and cost-effective hiring.
Monitor and report Brazil-specific TA metrics such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, candidate quality, early attrition (training/nesting), and hiring manager satisfaction.
Partner with Training & Quality teams to ensure hiring quality translates into strong operational performance and first-90-day retention.
Identify process bottlenecks and implement automation, analytics, and digital recruitment tools to optimize hiring outcomes nationwide.
4. Stakeholder & Client Management
Act as the primary Talent Acquisition point of contact for Brazil business leaders, client representatives, and external partners.
Collaborate with Client Services and Operations to support new business transitions, site expansions, and staffing proposals within Brazil.
Participate in client presentations, RFP responses, and site visits, representing Brazil TA capabilities, performance, and innovation.
Build and sustain strong partnerships with Brazilian universities, job boards, government labor programs, and community organizations to ensure robust national talent pipelines.
5. Data-Driven Decision Making
Utilize recruitment analytics and Brazilian labor market intelligence to drive strategic decisions and recommend data-backed solutions.
Develop and maintain national dashboards to ensure visibility of hiring performance and enable agile workforce decisions.
Present regular updates to Brazil executive leadership on hiring trends, risks, productivity, and achievements.
6. Employer Branding & Candidate Experience
Lead employer branding initiatives within Brazil to position the company as an employer of choice in the Brazilian BPO sector.
Ensure a consistent, inclusive, and culturally relevant candidate experience aligned with company values and employer brand.
Promote Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) through targeted outreach and recruitment strategies aligned with Brazil’s diversity landscape.
7. Compliance & Governance
Ensure all recruitment activities comply with Brazilian labor legislation, data protection laws (including LGPD), and ethical hiring standards.
Maintain audit readiness and process documentation aligned with internal controls and external compliance requirements (e.g., COPC, ISO, or client-specific standards).
8. Innovation & Continuous Improvement
Drive adoption of AI, automation, and digital recruitment marketing to modernize hiring practices across Brazil.
Benchmark national practices against Brazilian BPO and talent acquisition market leaders to introduce best-in-class models.
Integrate predictive analytics and skill-based hiring approaches to anticipate Brazil’s future workforce needs.
Requirements
10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role. Fluent in English and advanced Spanish proficiency (Spanish is not a must). Proven experience leading high-volume, multi-site recruitment operations in Brazil (BPO or multinational environment). Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field (MBA or postgraduate preferred).
Strong knowledge of the Brazilian labor market, labor legislation, and LGPD.
Demonstrated expertise in workforce planning, large-scale ramp-ups, and recruitment analytics (KPIs, dashboards, cost control).
Experience implementing and optimizing ATS, CRM, and digital/AI-driven sourcing tools. (Workday)
Strong stakeholder management and client-facing skills.

title: Gerente de aterro sanitário
description:
A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.
A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.
Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.
Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Conduzir análises de viabilidade técnica e econômica para expansão de capacidade, purificação para biometano ou ampliação da geração de energia.
Profissional com experiência comprovada em gás combustível de fonte renovável e Unidade de disposição final de resíduos sólidos, com atuação direta na gestão, monitoramento e análise de indicadores operacionais e ambientais do sistema de extração e aproveitamento energético do gás gerado por digestão anaeróbia.
Sólida vivência em sítios de destinação final ambientalmente controlados, incluindo controle de eficiência de captação, monitoramento de vazão, pressão, teor de metano (CH₄), oxigênio (O₂) e demais parâmetros críticos de desempenho.
Experiência na operação e manutenção da Unidade de Captação e Queima, com acompanhamento de KPIs como disponibilidade do sistema,controle de emissões e performance de flares.
Implementar planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva.
Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares (operação, manutenção, meio ambiente e engenharia).
Sólida vivência com controle e atendimento ao monitoramento do projeto de MDL.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical professional to join our TMF Funds team. This role is responsible for ensuring the accurate calculation of Net Asset Value (NAV) , managing settlements, performing reconciliation of assets and liabilities, supporting accounting processes, and handling invoicing.
As an Analyst , you will play a key role in supporting the TMF team, collaborating across departments to deliver high-quality service to clients. You will assist in managing the full lifecycle of offshore funds—especially those linked to Wealth Management—from onboarding and transaction processing to reporting and client query resolution. This role requires strong attention to detail, a process-oriented mindset, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
Core Responsibilities
Your responsibilities fall into the following categories:
Fund and Investor Onboarding Client Relationship & Query Management Collaboration with Fund Accounting & Shared Center Teams Fund Transaction Processing & Reporting
Audit Support
Daily Tasks
(i) Fund and Investor Onboarding
Including, but not limited to:
Ensure all required forms are completed and approved in compliance with regulatory guidelines.
Register new investors in the RTA systems according to the Step-by-Step Manual, ensuring all data is complete and accurate.
Identify documentation gaps and communicate proactively with internal teams.
Work with KYC teams to notify clients of issues that may delay investor redemptions or distributions.
(ii) Investor Transaction Processing & Reporting
Including, but not limited to:
Enter investor transactions into RTA systems with full accuracy.
Review trade documentation and follow up on missing or incomplete information.
Prepare investor statements for internal review, ensuring compliance with records and regulations.
Prepare and submit wire payments to Treasury, following call-back procedures.
Ensure investor reporting is delivered within SLAs.
Maintain complete and accurate documentation of investors, transactions, communications, and approvals in internal platforms.
(iii) Client Relationship & Query Management
Including, but not limited to:
Assist with investor queries, providing high-quality service with proper guidance.
Monitor communication channels such as Teams and investor/client distribution email inboxes.
Track client requests and follow up on pending actions.
(iv) Collaboration with Fund Accounting & Shared Center Teams
Including, but not limited to:
Partner with the accounting team to ensure timely reconciliation of investor activity.
Monitor and support teams in executing fund processes, ensuring timely capital calls, distributions, and transaction bookings aligned with the NAV cycle. (v) Fund Transaction Processing & Reporting
a) NAV Calculation
Perform daily, weekly, or monthly NAV calculations for assigned funds.
Ensure accuracy in valuations, pricing, and corporate actions.
b) Settlements & Reconciliation
Manage trade settlements across various asset classes.
Reconcile cash, positions, and transactions with custodians.
Investigate and resolve discrepancies promptly.
c) Accounting & Processing
Maintain general ledger entries for fund assets and liabilities.
Process accruals, amortizations, and expense allocations.
Support fund accounting to ensure compliance with internal controls.
d) Invoicing & Reporting
Prepare and issue invoices for fund expenses and management fees.
Assist with financial statements and investor reports.
Provide data and analysis for audits and regulatory filings.
(vi) Additional Strategic Expectations
Share insights to improve processes and enhance client service delivery.
Stay updated on industry, regulatory, and jurisdictional trends.
Contribute to the development of new products and business solutions.
Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, business teams, project managers, and implementation teams.
Required Skills & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics , or a related field. Experience in the Offshore Fund Administration industry. Knowledge of offshore structures such as CIMA (Cayman Islands), Delaware, and Ontario . High proficiency in Office 365 (Excel, Word, Teams). Experience with investor management systems or fund administration platforms is a plus. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a focus on process optimization.
Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work accurately in a fast-paced environment.
High proficiency in spoken and written English , particularly for communication with US-based clients. Strong knowledge of NAV calculation , settlements , and reconciliation . Excellent communication skills for interactions with custodians, auditors, and internal teams.

title: Senior manager medical affairs
description:
The Senior Manager, Medical Affairs will be responsible for our Injectables aesthetics business.
This role will report to our Brazil Country Lead with a dotted report line to the Global Medical Affairs.
Location
Brazil (São Paulo preferred; hybrid/field-based with national travel)

The Senior Manager, Medical Affairs – Brazil is responsible for leading and executing the local medical strategy for the injectable aesthetic portfolio. This includes medical leadership for two promoted products and governance and rollout of a new or updated injectable protocol. The role ensures scientific excellence, compliant medical engagement, strong KOL partnerships, and effective cross-functional collaboration with Commercial, Regulatory, Quality, and Market Access teams.

Develop and execute the Brazil Medical Plan aligned with global strategy and country business priorities.
Provide medical input into brand plans, ensuring all claims and materials are evidence-based and compliant.
Lead medical governance and adaptation of new injectable protocols, including scientific rationale, safety considerations, and training framework.
Establish version control and structured review processes for protocol updates.
Build and manage strategic relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), anaesthesiologists, and relevant specialists.
Lead advisory boards, expert meetings, and scientific exchange activities.
Design and deliver high-quality medical education for internal teams and healthcare professionals.

Partner cross-functionally with Regulatory (including ANVISA requirements), Quality, Commercial, and Market Access.
Provide timely and scientifically robust responses to medical inquiries.

Advanced scientific or clinical degree (MD, Pharm D, MSc, or Ph D preferred).
Minimum 8–10 years’ experience in Medical Affairs, Clinical, or Scientific roles within injectables, anaesthesia, hospital products, or specialty pharma.
Strong experience supporting product launches and lifecycle management.
Demonstrated expertise in KOL engagement and medical education program development.
Solid understanding of pharmacovigilance and compliance requirements in Brazil.
Fluent Portuguese and strong English proficiency.
Success Measures (KPIs)
Effective delivery of Brazil Medical Plan and launch readiness milestones.
Successful rollout and adoption of new injectable protocol.
Strong KOL engagement and quality scientific exchange.
Full compliance with PV and regulatory standards.
High-quality cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder satisfaction

title: Product designer
description:
Sigma MD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.
Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:

Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.
This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:

Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.
Required Skills
2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
Experience with Figma.
Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques
Desired Skills
Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
Experience with Jira and Confluence.
Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Consultor de processos - secagem
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.
Sobre a Arauco Brasil
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.
Sobre a Função
Desafios:
Oferecer suporte técnico especializado na operação e otimização dos processos de secagem de polpa celulósica, através do mapeamento, monitoramento dos processos e gestão dos recursos, consumos de insumos e materiais de operação, sistemas e equipamentos, assegurando a produtividade das máquinas de secagem, dentro do padrão de qualidade e eficiência, otimizando custos e minimizando desperdício, através de intervenções nos parâmetros e processos, implementação de novas tecnologias ou métodos de produção, visando a melhoria contínua no desempenho dos equipamentos e melhor qualidade da Celulose, bem como, realizar a gestão técnica dos operadores da sua área de atuação.
Principais Atividades:
Desenvolver, validar e implementar planos de otimização do processo de secagem de polpa celulósica, garantindo eficiência operacional, qualidade do produto e melhor utilização de recursos.
Promover a melhoria contínua dos sistemas de secagem, com foco em eficiência energética, redução de custos, sustentabilidade e minimização de perdas.
Monitorar as operações diárias, assegurando conformidade com padrões de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente.
Pesquisar, analisar e aplicar novas tecnologias e práticas para aprimorar desempenho, confiabilidade e impacto ambiental do processo.
Garantir que o produto final atenda aos requisitos de qualidade, realizando análises, testes e ajustes necessários.
Capacitar e orientar equipes operacionais, disseminando melhores práticas e apoiando o desenvolvimento técnico, inclusive em fases de startup.
Atuar de forma integrada com Engenharia, Manutenção, Qualidade, Logística e Comercial em projetos de melhoria, inovação e aumento da disponibilidade dos ativos.
Participar do planejamento e execução de Paradas Gerais, contribuindo para mitigação de riscos e otimização de custos.
Implantar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (custos, produtividade, disponibilidade), promovendo ajustes e evolução contínua dos processos.
Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Saúde Ocupacional e Compliance.
Requisitos Obrigatórios:
Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
Pós-graduação ou especialização em Celulose e Papel, Gestão de Projetos, Lean Manufacturing ou áreas afins;
Sólida experiência em indústria de celulose;
Vivência em comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
Conhecimento consolidado em sistemas de gestão da qualidade (normas ISO);
Experiência com metodologias de análise e solução de problemas;
Conhecimento em design experimental (DOE) e estatística avançada;
Conhecimento em gestão com foco no cliente;
Domínio técnico dos processos de Secagem;
Amplo conhecimento do processo produtivo de celulose e papel;
Experiência com Sistema PIMS e Balanço de Produção;
Vivência em Gestão da Rotina Diária (GRD);
Inglês e Espanhol serão considerados diferenciais;
Disponibilidade para atuar em Inocência/MS.

title: Ai engineer - full stack builder
description:
About Cambay Solutions
Cambay Solutions is the technology arm of the Cambay Group, a 1,300-employee organization headquartered in Houston, Texas. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner holding all six solution designations, we help enterprises across healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, and government transform operations through Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and AI. Our AI Practice operates as the strategic hub that powers intelligent solutions across every Cambay practice area.
About the Role
At Cambay, our Full Stack Builders take client solutions end-to-end – combining architecture, development, AI integration, and user experience to deliver what traditionally required a team of 5–10 specialists.
As a Full Stack Builder in the AI Practice, you will own the complete solution lifecycle for client engagements. Using AI-powered development tools and the Azure ecosystem, you will design, build, and ship solutions that solve real enterprise problems. This is not a generalist role – it’s a new category of consulting professional who leverages AI to amplify their capabilities across the entire delivery stack.
Key Responsibilities
• End-to-End Delivery – Own client solutions from discovery through deployment – you are responsible for the complete delivery lifecycle within your pod engagements
• AI-Powered Development – Leverage Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and custom AI agents to accelerate development across spec writing, design, architecture, and code
• Azure Architecture – Design and implement scalable solutions using Azure services – App Service, Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure AI, Container Apps, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365
• User Experience – Create user experiences using modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js) with AI-assisted prototyping and design systems
• AI Integration – Embed Azure Open AI, Cognitive Services, Copilot Studio agents, and custom AI features into client solutions
• Client Engagement – Participate in client discovery, contribute to solution estimation and SOWs, and communicate technical approaches to non-technical stakeholders
• Ship & Iterate – Deploy to production on client Azure tenants, configure monitoring, gather feedback, and iterate based on real-world usage
• Cross-Practice Collaboration – Work within Cambay’s Hub-and-Spoke model, collaborating with domain specialists in Modern Work, D365, and Data & Analytics practices
Required Qualifications
Technical Foundation
• Proficiency in at least one programming language (Type Script, Python, C# preferred)
• Experience building and deploying applications on Azure (or equivalent cloud platform)
• Understanding of modern web development (React, APIs, databases)
• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, integration patterns, and Azure AI services
• Experience with Power Platform and/or Dynamics 365 integration is a strong plus
Consulting & Delivery Mindset
• Comfort working directly with enterprise clients – discovery sessions, demos, technical walkthroughs
• Ability to work across multiple concurrent engagements within pod structures
• Demonstrated ability to identify client problems and translate them into implementable solutions
• Track record of shipping solutions that deliver measurable business value
AI-Native Working Style
• Active use of AI coding assistants (Git Hub Copilot, Codex, Claude Code, etc.) as part of daily workflow
• Comfort with rapid experimentation and learning new tools under delivery timelines
• Curiosity to explore how AI can amplify your capabilities and accelerate client delivery
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Azure, Microsoft Foundry platform and Agent 365
• Familiarity with Copilot Studio agent development
• Azure certifications (AI Engineer Associate, Developer Associate, Solutions Architect)
• Experience with design tools (Figma) or AI-assisted prototyping
• Healthcare, financial services, or government domain experience
• Background in consulting, professional services, or agency delivery environments
How We’ll Evaluate You
We value demonstrated capability over credentials. You may apply with a traditional resume, or you can show us what you’ve built:
• Demo Video – Walk us through a solution you’ve built (2–3 minutes). Show the problem, your approach, and the outcome.
• Why & How – Explain why you built it, the architectural decisions you made, and what you learned.
• AI Usage – Tell us how you used AI tools in your process – we want to see your AI-native workflow in action.

description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.
Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

About the opportunity:
Please prioritize senior-level Data/MLOps Engineers with strong coding ability and clear communication. Candidates must be able to clearly explain their approach, design decisions, trade offs, and alternatives, and articulate end-to-end MLOps architecture. Candidates with average coding skills or limited ability to communicate ideas will not be considered.
Data Engineer (MLOps Focus)Team & Scope
The team owns the entire data pipeline , from ingestion to downstream consumption. Data Engineering and MLOps responsibilities are combined , and the team supports multiple projects simultaneously. This is primarily a Data Engineering role , with strong exposure to MLOps and ML integration . Technical Focus
The team writes significantly less SQL compared to a typical Data Engineering team. There is a large Business Analyst team responsible for providing raw data and writing most of the SQL. Candidates must be comfortable with SQL , but in day to day work, SQL usage is limited. Strong programming and system design skills are critical, similar to a traditional Software Engineering role. Python is the main programming language, but strong experience in Java or Scala is also acceptable. The ideal profile is a generalist , not a specialist. Key expectations include:
Writing production grade code
Designing scalable systems
Orchestrating end to end data and ML pipelines
Integrating ML models into broader systems
SQL is considered an additional skill , not the core focus.

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the Compass Uol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Gerente de projetos - saneamento
description:
QUADRANTE – Grupo internacional de engenharia, com forte atuação em Energia, Mobilidade e Cidades Sustentáveis, e presença crescente em projetos financiados por instituições financeiras internacionais.
Buscamos um Gerente de Projetos experiente e estratégico para liderar a gestão de projetos de saneamento. O profissional ideal terá um profundo conhecimento técnico em projetos de saneamento, incluindo sistemas de abastecimento de água, esgotamento sanitário, redes, adutoras e coletores, associadas a Quadrante junto aos nossos clientes em todas as fases do projeto.
Esta posição é fundamental para orquestrar as entregas, garantir a comunicação eficaz com o cliente e assegurar que os projetos avancem em alinhamento com os padrões de excelência da Quadrante, em estreita colaboração com as equipes técnicas e a diretoria de operações.
Responsabilidades:
• Liderar o planejamento, execução, monitoramento e encerramento dos projetos de saneamento (abastecimento de água, esgotamento sanitário, ETEs, ETAs, redes, adutoras e obras associadas), assegurando alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa e com os requisitos contratuais.
• Atuar como principal ponto focal técnico e gerencial perante o cliente, mantendo comunicação clara, tempestiva e estruturada em todas as fases do projeto, fortalecendo relações de confiança e garantindo o correto entendimento das necessidades e expectativas.
• Gerenciar integralmente o escopo, cronograma, orçamento, qualidade, riscos e recursos dos projetos, aplicando metodologias consolidadas de gerenciamento (PMI, PMBOK, Agile adaptado a engenharia, ou similares), garantindo entregas dentro dos padrões acordados.
• Coordenar o desenvolvimento técnico junto a equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia sanitária, hidráulica, ambiental, civil, geotecnia, topografia, BIM, orçamento e planejamento), garantindo integração entre disciplinas e consistência técnica entre os produtos entregues.
• Acompanhar a evolução física e financeira dos projetos, realizando reuniões periódicas de alinhamento com líderes de equipe, identificando desvios, implementando ações corretivas e comunicando riscos antecipadamente ao cliente e à direção interna.
• Gerenciar o contrato de forma estratégica: acompanhar termos, escopo contratado, aditivos, medição de serviços, fluxo de entregáveis, negociação de pleitos e suporte direto às áreas jurídica, financeira e de operações quanto a compliance e obrigações contratuais.
• Assegurar a qualidade dos projetos entregues por atenderem os desempenhos operacionais e econômicos requeridos pelas boas práticas e pelas Normas Técnicas brasileiras produzidas pela ABNT ou na falta delas normas ASTM ou ISO e diretrizes das Concessionárias, as normas ambientais e de segurança aplicáveis.
• Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e apresentações executivas para direção e clientes, consolidando status de projeto, risco, indicadores de desempenho, decisões pendentes e planos de ação.
• Mapear oportunidades de melhoria contínua, propondo soluções técnicas, otimizações de processo, inovações e uso de tecnologias (BIM, SIG, modelagem hidráulica, automação de processos) para aumentar eficiência e agregar valor ao cliente.
• Representar tecnicamente a empresa em reuniões, workshops e visitas a campo, garantindo visão integrada das condições reais do sistema e alinhamento entre projeto, execução e necessidades operacionais.
• Promover um ambiente colaborativo, orientando equipes, fomentando boas práticas de gestão e assegurando comunicação fluida entre todas as disciplinas e partes envolvidas.
Formação & Qualificações
• Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Sanitária ou áreas correlatas.
• Registro profissional ativo (CREA).
• Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Saneamento, Infraestrutura ou Gestão Empresarial (desejável).
• Certificações como PMP, CAPM, Prince2, Scrum Master ou similares são diferenciais valorizados em gerenciamento de projetos de engenharia.
Experiência Profissional:
• Experiência comprovada na coordenação ou gerenciamento de projetos de saneamento, incluindo:
– sistemas de abastecimento de água
– esgotamento sanitário
– redes, adutoras e coletores
– ETEs, ETAs, elevatórias
– obras de infraestrutura associadas
• Vivência em empresas de engenharia, consultoria, concessionárias de água/esgoto ou projetos públicos.
• Experiência na liderança de equipes multidisciplinares (hidráulica, civil, ambiental, geotecnia, BIM etc.).
• Histórico na gestão completa do ciclo de vida de projetos: planejamento, execução, monitoramento, controle e encerramento.
• Experiência em análise de contratos, aditivos, pleitos, medição e interface com clientes públicos e privados.
Conhecimentos Técnicos:

– MS Project
– Pacote Office (Excel avançado)
– ferramentas de controle de indicadores (Power BI é diferencial)

– Auto CAD

– legislações ambientais e regulatórias

title: Projetista elétrico pleno
description:
Sobre a Gruen
Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.
Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.
Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.
Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.
Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.
Objetivo do Cargo
Projetista Elétrico Pleno será responsável por desenvolver projetos de infraestrutura elétrica para plantas industriais, atuará na elaboração de desenhos técnicos, especificações de materiais e equipamentos, e auxiliará na preparação de documentação para cotações de montagem elétrica, contribuindo ativamente para a execução de projetos inovadores e eficientes.
Atribuições:

Elaboração de Desenhos Técnicos: Desenvolver e detalhar projetos de infraestrutura elétrica para plantas industriais, incluindo layouts, rotas de cabos, detalhamento de suportes típicos de instalação, utilizando software Auto CAD / Plant 3 D.
Modelagem 3 D: Criar e revisar modelos 3 D de instalações elétricas em ambiente Plant 3 D ou ferramenta similar, garantindo a compatibilidade com projeto mecânico e a otimização do espaço.
Dimensionamento e Especificação: Realizar o dimensionamento e a especificação de componentes elétricos como leitos e eletrocalhas, bandejas, eletrodutos, condutores, e demais equipamentos relacionados à solução.
Elaboração de Documentação Técnica: Preparar especificações técnicas para compra de materiais e serviços, memórias de cálculo, listas de materiais e outros documentos pertinentes ao projeto.
Requisições de Cotação: Auxiliar na elaboração e detalhamento de requisições de cotação para montagem elétrica, garantindo clareza e precisão para fornecedores.
Aplicação de Normas: Assegurar que todos os projetos estejam em conformidade com as normas técnicas aplicáveis, com especial atenção às NBR 5410 (Instalações Elétricas de Baixa Tensão), NBR 5419 (Proteção de Estruturas Contra Descargas Atmosféricas) e NBR-IEC (Atmosferas Explosivas – Projeto, Seleção e Montagem de Instalações Elétricas).
Interface com Outras Disciplinas: Trabalhar em colaboração com outras equipes de engenharia (mecânica e processo) para garantir a integração e a compatibilidade dos projetos.
Suporte à Montagem: Prestar suporte técnico à equipe de montagem durante a execução do projeto, esclarecendo dúvidas e propondo soluções para eventuais desafios.
Requisitos:

Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
Curso Técnico em Eletrotécnica ou Eletroeletrônica com experiência relevante e comprovada.
Experiência: Sólida experiência como Projetista Elétrico, preferencialmente em projetos industriais. Experiência em plantas químicas será um diferencial.

title: Sales engineer
description:
About Credix
is a Fin Tech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2 B transactions in Brazil with our platform, . Credi Pay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.
Why choose Credix?
Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.
About the job
We are looking for someone to join Credix as a Sales Engineer . You will own the technical success of client integrations, from pre-sales feasibility to production go-live, ensuring fast activation and long-term integration stability.
Responsibilities Technical pre-sales validation: Lead technical pre-sales by validating feasibility, defining integration scope, and identifying risks before commercial commitment. Integration delivery and go-live readiness: Support sellers through implementation and testing, and act as the technical authority to approve or block go-live based on readiness criteria. Post-go-live integration reliability: Ensure the ongoing health of live integrations by owning issue triage, resolution, or escalation within 24 business hours. Feedback loop to Product and Engineering: Translate integration learnings into actionable feedback to improve platform reliability, scalability, and integration speed. Align technical decisions with commercial outcomes: Partner closely with Sales and Account Managers to ensure integrations support activation, retention, and GMV growth.
Customer-facing engagement: Frequently travel to customer sites across Brazil to support integrations, technical alignment, and relationship building.
Qualifications
Strong experience working with REST APIs, including authentication, webhooks, error handling, and data modeling.
Prior exposure to complex system integrations, preferably in e-commerce platforms (e.g., VTEX) or ERPs.
Comfortable working with SQL to investigate integration behavior, validate data flows, and support issue triage using BI tools such as Hex or equivalent.
Able to use monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Kibana or equivalent) to identify, diagnose, and communicate production integration issues.
Able to produce clear, concise, and structured technical documentation for external partners and internal teams.
Organized, proactive, and reliable in driving integrations forward across multiple stakeholders.
Curious about customer contexts and constraints, while able to design pragmatic, repeatable integration solutions rather than one-off custom builds.
Prioritizes customer success while balancing platform scalability, reliability, and long-term architectural constraints.
Operates with high autonomy and ownership, demonstrating strong prioritization, self-direction, and accountability while executing against ambitious targets.
What we offer
Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.
But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:
- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Construir e executar o plano de comunicação da mudança;

Integrar o plano de mudança ao cronograma do programa;
Participar de ritos de governança e status reports;
Apoiar a gestão de impactos em releases, pilotos e rollouts;
Coletar feedback contínuo e promover ajustes na estratégia de mudança;
Definir e acompanhar KPIs de mudança (adoção, engajamento, satisfação);
Avaliar readiness organizacional e evolução pós-implantação;
Apoiar a captura e realização dos benefícios do programa.
Requisitos e qualificações
Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas;
Certificação em Change Management (Prosci, CCMP ou similar);
Vivência em programas de transformação digital;
Conhecimento de metodologias de mudança (ex.: Prosci / ADKAR, Kotter ou similares);
Experiência com projetos de grande escala e múltiplos stakeholders;
Capacidade de análise de impacto organizacional;
Experiência com estratégias de comunicação e treinamento;
Familiaridade com ambientes ágeis e híbridos (Agile + PMO).
Informações adicionais
BENEFÍ CIOS:
Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);

Bônus anual;
Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;

Desconto em passagens áreas;

Ginástica laboral, conforme a localidade.

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.
VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁ CIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL
Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!
Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.
Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos. Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .
Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: Data compression engineer
description:
About
Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.
***
This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Data Compression Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.
You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .
The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.
Key Responsibilities Analyze, implement, and optimize lossless compression algorithms Evaluate novel compression techniques and validate performance claims through benchmarking and profiling
Improve compression ratio, throughput, latency, and memory efficiency across diverse file types
Design and optimize high-performance compression libraries and pipelines
Conduct algorithmic experimentation and critical validation of compression models
Develop benchmarking frameworks to evaluate performance across datasets and workloads
Collaborate with the core engineering team to productionize compression systems
Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong focus on systems programming
Demonstrated experience working with data compression algorithms Examples: LZ-family (LZ4, LZ77, LZMA), Huffman coding, arithmetic coding, Brotli, Zstandard, etc.
Strong understanding of: entropy encoding, algorithmic complexity, memory and CPU trade-offs, compression benchmarking
Proficiency in C, C++, Rust, or other high-performance systems languages Experience with performance profiling and optimization Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities
Comfortable evaluating unconventional or experimental approaches to algorithm design
Nice to Have Experience working at a major technology company, infrastructure company, or cloud provider Background in high-performance computing, distributed systems, or storage systems Experience implementing or optimizing compression codecs
Experience with Gen AI or advanced software development workflows Contributions to open-source compression libraries
Experience designing benchmarking frameworks for algorithm evaluation
Nice to Have
Experience working with large-scale distributed storage systems
Knowledge of columnar storage formats (Parquet, ORC)
Experience with streaming systems (Kafka, Pulsar)
Exposure to ML-based or adaptive compression techniques
Contributions to open-source compression libraries
Experience with SIMD, vectorization, or GPU acceleration
Benefits
Yearly Office Allowance Budget
Macbook Purchase Support
Wellbeing Support
If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through Linked In.
Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

description:

Location: Sao Paolo Area: Corporate & Investment Banking / Global Markets/FX Languages: Fluent English (please share CV in English)

We are looking for a Business Analyst with experience in FX Markets to join our team and contribute to the design and delivery of key initiatives across pricing, trading, e FX, and post-trade workflows. This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical capabilities, a solid understanding of FX products, and experience defining functional and API requirements in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
What You Will Be Doing As a Business Analyst in the FX Technology & Change team, your responsibilities will include:
Requirements & Functional Analysis
Collect and document business requirements across FX trading, pricing, liquidity, and market connectivity.
Translate business needs into clear functional specifications , user stories , and acceptance criteria . Define and maintain API specifications (data models, message structures, integration logic). Map end-to-end processes and identify improvement opportunities aligned with digital transformation strategy.
Project Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration
Work closely with Front Office, Middle Office, Product Owners, Architecture, and Technology teams.
Contribute to test planning, clarify requirements for QA teams, and support UAT activities.
Collaborate effectively across a global organization, ensuring alignment with CIB standards and governance.
Documentation & Tools Produce high-quality documentation using Jira and Confluence , ensuring traceability and auditability. Apply AI tools to streamline analysis, documentation, and communication tasks. Maintain clear and concise functional artefacts consistent with internal guidelines.
What We Are Looking For
Required Experience & Skills
At least 3 years of experience in FX Markets (spot, forwards, swaps, NDFs, or e FX). Proven experience defining API requirements and working with integration teams. Medium-level proficiency with Jira and Confluence . Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex topics in a clear and structured manner.
Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in electronic trading platforms, market connectivity, or algo trading.
Experience using AI-based productivity tools in daily workflows (Chat GPT, Rovo) Understanding of regulatory frameworks impacting FX (e.g., Mi FID II).
Familiarity with Agile delivery models within financial services.
Knowledge of SQL or Python for data validation is a plus.
What We Offer
The opportunity to contribute to key transformation initiatives within Global Markets business.
A collaborative and diverse working environment with global exposure.
Professional growth and learning opportunities through CIB programs and digital skills development.
The chance to work with cutting-edge technology and innovative market solutions.

title: Research engineer, multimodal
description:
The Role
We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.
This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.
We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.
What You'll Do
1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments
Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.
2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data
Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions. 3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs
Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement. 4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams
Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.
Who We're Looking For
1. Required Qualifications
4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.
2. Highly valued experience
RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLa VA, GPT-4 V, Gemini, or equivalent).
Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).
Why Turing
Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.
Why Turing
Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.
Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.
Advantages of joining Turing:
Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, Linked In etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
Competitive compensation
Flexible working hours

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. title: Ui/ux designer
description:
UI/UX Designer
Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level
About the Role
We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.
This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.
We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.
What You'll Do
• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff
• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions
• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration
• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements
• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products
• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership
• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch
What We're Looking For
Must-Have Experience
• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment
• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design
• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping
• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints
• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value
• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined
Nice to Have
• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2 B users
• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals
• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products
• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up
How We Work
Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.
We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.
What You'll Get
• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration
• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges
• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Research engineer, coding agents
description:
About Turing
Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including Open AI, Anthropic, Google Deep Mind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.
The Role
We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.
This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.
We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.
What You'll Do:
1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents
Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.
2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data
Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.
3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs
Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.
4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams
Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.
Who We're Looking For:
1. Required Qualifications
4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.
2. Highly valued experience
Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, Human Eval, or equivalent).
RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows
Why Turing
Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.
Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.
Advantages of joining Turing:
Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, Linked In etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
Competitive compensation
Flexible working hours
Don’t meet every single requirement?
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here .
